title: 🚌 Finding Your Place in the Body
subtitle: Not every job is up front, and that's perfectly okay.

intro.title: A Place to Serve
paragraphs: Some are called to preach and teach. Some to sing. Some to keep up the church grounds, drive the bus, or do the paperwork. All Christians are part of the body of Christ, and we all have a job to do. God has different jobs for each of us.

For years I tried to jump into jobs without first asking Him, and those never lasted long. Then, in prayer, I realized God had given me my job at the beginning of my Christian journey, and I've been doing it ever since. It seemed so small that I never thought of it as a calling, but God has been faithful to grow it.

verses.text: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office: so we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
For who hath despised the day of small things?
Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

blocks.title: A Thought to Carry With You
paragraphs: Ask Him where He wants you. You might already be there. 💛

footer.heading: Your Work Matters
footer.text: God can use the quiet, faithful work that others may never see.

card.title: Finding Your Place in the Body
card.summary: A reflection on finding your calling in service, even when the work feels small.

seo.title: Finding Your Place in the Body - Geeky Grands
seo.description: A devotional reflection on serving in the role God has given you, with KJV verses about the body of Christ and small things.
